reuse.why: Takes its category set from the shared getMonthWideCategories and writes through setBudget/batchMessages/undoable like its siblings, reading the prior month's sum-amount cell directly since no single-month spending helper exists.

duplication.why: The loop body repeats the sibling actions' income-skip guard (is_income && !isTrackingBudget) and expense sign flip inline instead of sharing them, adding one more copy of a pattern already repeated in actions.ts.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to setZero and set3MonthAvg and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like the others.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration/type and tests are added.

maintainability.why: Follows the established shape of the month-wide actions closely, so it is easy to own, though the per-action guard and sign rule stay copied.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getMonthWideCategories, setBudget, batchMessages and the undoable mutator wrapper.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied income guard and sign flip in setLastMonthSpending are written in the same form as in set3MonthAvg, not disguised.
